name: RAD-140

lead: RAD-140 (testolone) is a nonsteroidal selective androgen receptor modulator developed by Radius Health, studied in preclinical models for muscle and breast cancer. It has never completed human efficacy trials.
It is sold as a research chemical for muscle gain, with little human data.

paras: It binds the androgen receptor with tissue selectivity and suppresses natural androgen production.
Not approved and banned in sport. Case reports link it to drug-induced liver injury, and it suppresses hormones. Evidence of its safety is insufficient. Products may be mislabelled.
